name: thin-undeclared-codex-marker
title: Undeclared codex usage from a pack-shipped doc blocks every conversion
description: The pack ships .claude/sd-ai-command-pack/planning-adversarial-review.md, which invokes the codex CLI. No consumer declares codex, so the thin resweep reports undeclared codex usage as a packDefect in all eight consumers and no conversion reaches a clear verdict. RESOLVED 2026-08-11 (option 3, design.md D6): split the document -- the 80-line host contract keeps shipping to every consumer as platform claude, and the 49-line Codex lane moves to docs/planning-adversarial-review-codex.md in the pack repository, with no manifest.json row and nothing under templates/, so it reaches no consumer. Option 5 (ship the lane under a platform codex row) was implemented in full and then rejected: three tested invariants encode that codex ships no manifest files, and satisfying them by giving codex markers would auto-select it in all eight consumers and reinstate the packDefect. Options 1, 2, 4, and 5 are all rejections. The operator accepted the capability loss on 2026-08-11 and chose option 3 knowing it is permanent: consumers whose developers have the Codex CLI on PATH lose the lane, and there is no per-consumer restore path.
creator: sdelmas
